scope: Discrete flash/tone onsets and AV offset on five 6 s synthetic controls. Not semantic understanding, real-content accuracy or perceptual approval.

coverage: tones -6 to -24 dBFS RMS over -50 dBFS noise
gradual fade and steady noise produce zero events
bright and dark localized flashes of varied size/position
documented limit: event under 12 dB above the trailing local level not counted
percussive hits over a continuous music-like bed after a silent intro (v1 found 1/5; v2 finds 5/5)
onset straddling the 10 s streaming chunk boundary located within 1 ms
offset by consensus with 8 non-phase-locked distractor onsets around 4 flashes
phase-locked distractors and a single flash among many onsets are reported AMBIGUOUS

mutation_check.method: Constants changed on a temporary copy; qualification and/or tests must fail.
caught: video top-decile metric replaced by whole-frame mean
mutation_check.removed_after_check: An onset-refinement stage changed no result (1 ms windows are not affected by AAC pre-echo in these cases) and was removed rather than kept untested.

changes_v2: local-novelty audio onsets (trailing 20-210 ms median) replace the whole-file floor rule
sample-level onset refinement and per-event resolution fields
bounded-memory streaming with numpy; audio and video measured in parallel
first-block baseline padding so a background present from t=0 is not an onset

consensus offset pairing with AMBIGUOUS verdict (first real-opening injection run 38992560157 detected 30/30 audio and 30/30 video events with zero spurious events but failed on nearest-neighbour pairing against natural music onsets)
